watches.name: Submarine Canyon
watches.description: Discover Submarine Canyon, a limited-edition engraved enamel watch with a deep blue Grand Feu enamel dial, crafted by independent enamelists at O&HoraPictor. Through Every View DUET We present two enamel hues independently on a single dial. Beneath the distinctive lustre unique to Grand Feu enamel, a subtle dialogue unfolds. The two tones echo one another, fulfilling a new expression in each other’s complement. This timepiece embodies the poetic beauty of two distinct elements, uplifting one another and ascending together into a unified work of art. The DUET series presents this delicate new birth.https://www.horapictor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/DUET-m-s.mp4https://www.horapictor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/DUET.mp4 Minimalism At its core, DUET is defined by the interplay and mutual elevation of two distinct elements. The Submarine Canyon marks an evolution of the DUET philosophy. Reduced to a unified colour tone, the warm enamel and engraved silver base form the two voices of the duet. Where colour divisions fall away, the quiet cadence of light and shadow takes their place. The smooth enamel and textured engraving — one still, one dynamic — resonate in silent harmony as light shifts across the dial. This is the purest expression of the DUET ethos, distilled to its minimalist essence. Hand Engraving Artisans hand-engrave mountainous textures into a flat silver base, one precise cut at a time. The handcrafted process carries inherent variation, causing the texture to shift with every viewing angle. Head-on, it reveals a mountainous grain; from the side, a radiating sunburst; under dynamic lighting, an unexpected lightning-like pattern emerges. This is the defining allure of handcraftsmanship, unlocking new expressive potential for the enamel finish. Hand-Brushed Finish As the visual focal point of the DUET, the silver ring is hand-brushed repeatedly to achieve a delicate, fine-grained surface. This refined metallic texture adds layered detail to the piece, while creating a striking contrast with the enamel’s signature glossy luminosity. Indices Design Crisply printed onto the brushed silver ring, the precisely aligned markers carry a refined architectural sensibility. Roman numerals and the outer circular index ring exude understated elegance, with minute markers seamlessly integrated into the track to distill intricate marker detailing into clean, minimalist order. Case The DUET is housed in a 36mm/38m/40mm case with an elegantly refined profile. Evoking the structural aesthetics of classical architecture, they support the case with the poised, ordered presence of Roman columns. Its polished concave bezel sits in perfect balance with the enamel dial, accentuating the enamel’s signature lustre. The twisted lugs are gently downturned, their flowing multi-faceted surfaces meticulously polished into soft, fluid curves. Movement The DUET is equipped with the latest Sellita SW200-2M Power+ (Manual) movement. This calibre delivers a significant improvement in power reserve, offering 65 hours of power reserve and a precision rating of ±12 seconds per day, providing the DUET collection with a solid, reliable performance foundation. watches.name: Volcano Grey
watches.description: SUBMARINE VOLCANO Thousands of meters below the surface, where pressure crushes light into nothing, the ocean floor tears itself open. Molten rock meets freezing water. Chaos becomes form. Entire mountains are born in silence, invisible to everyone above. We were inspired by that moment – one of nature’s most powerful and invisible forces: submarine volcanic eruptions, hidden miles beneath a calm surface. Volcano grey enamel is layered atop handmade silver leaf, imbuing it with a profound, luminous radiance. Like light on the smoked ocean, it shifts with light, echoing the sea’s calm, smoky depth. The watch embodies the serene vastness of the ocean, as well as the tranquil calm that follows a volcanic eruption. Hand-Formed Silver Leaf Artisans meticulously hand-form silver leaf just four microns thick into undulating organic textures, the signature grain at the core of the Smoked Ocean dial collection. Fully handcrafted, no two silver leaf patterns are identical, making each timepiece one of a kind. Translucent Enamel Successive even coats of translucent enamel are applied across the dial, allowing light to penetrate the enamel to the underlying silver leaf and refract repeatedly between layers for a delicate, nuanced lustre. The built-up enamel lyres impart a soft visual depth and dimensionality, with hands, indices and silver leaf texture resting at distinct depths in complementary layered interplay. Indices Design Crisply hand printed onto the enamel dial, the precisely aligned markers carry a refined architectural sensibility. Roman numerals and the outer circular index ring exude understated elegance, with minute markers seamlessly integrated into the track to distill intricate marker detailing into clean, minimalist order. Pen Hands Inspired by pen nibs, the slender hands carry an elegant, refined character. Heat-blued second hand to a rich, deep, and glossy finish, they reveal subtle, intriguing curves as light catches their surface.
